final: WITH t AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COALESCE(SUM(f.transaction_amount),0) AS tot FROM Financial_Transactions f JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id=f.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), s AS (SELECT st, tot, tot*1.0/(SELECT SUM(tot) FROM t) AS sh FROM t), av AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS a FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.tot) AS combined_total, AVG(s.sh) AS avg_share, AVG(s.sh-av.a) AS avg_excess FROM s, av WHERE s.sh > av.a
